name: SUB/WAVE
description: SUB/WAVE turns your own music library into a self-hosted internet radio station. An AI DJ picks the tracks from Navidrome, talks between them with a local or cloud voice and runs shows, jingles and listener requests, while everyone hears the same Icecast stream.

notes.text: Open http://<IP>/onboarding and sign in with the admin password from ~/subwave.creds inside the container.
SUB/WAVE needs a Navidrome (Subsonic) server with your music and an LLM (Ollama, any OpenAI-compatible server or a cloud API key); the onboarding wizard connects both.
